benchmark_name: Sunborn Multi-Worker Concurrent Gateway Burst & Latency Distribution

workload.configuration: semantic cache disabled; exact-cache hot path after a single warmup request
workload.transport: in-process tower::ServiceExt::oneshot — no TCP, no TLS, no network hop

notes: Re-measured on 2026-11-18. A previous revision of this file carried 14,202.9 req/s with P50 0.068 ms and P99 0.144 ms as its 'release profile'. Those figures do not come from this test: they match crates/sunborn-gateway/tests/performance_test.rs, which drives 5,000 sequential requests and now records 13,241.1 req/s at P99 0.166 ms (see benchmarks/results/gateway_performance_run.json). Filing them here made an unreproducible claim out of a real measurement. This file now holds only what this test produces.
The debug numbers are what `cargo test` runs by default, which is the configuration the verification pipeline and CI use. Release is roughly 80x faster on this workload; expect the gap.

This is a burst, not endurance: 10,000 requests complete in under one second in release. It bounds the hot path's steady-state throughput. It does NOT demonstrate multi-hour stability or memory behaviour under sustained load.
Latency is measured in-process around the router. Adding a real network hop, TLS termination, or a proxy will raise these figures.
